doc: The game's mix (M2-AUD-02; docs/kb/audio/mix.md §4, docs/kb/tech/audio_runtime.md). The Audio autoload (game/audio/audio_director.gd) builds `buses` in order on start when they are missing: each sends to `send`. Assets ship at their loudness targets, so every bus is 0 dB; never fix an asset's loudness with a fader. `master_limiter`: a safety limiter on Master. `ducks`: a reason (dialogue: a dialogue box is open; battle: a battle scene is running) lowers buses by these dB, ramping at `sec`; ducks of different reasons add. `music`: crossfade_sec is the default music change, battle_in_sec the field-to-battle cut, floor_db the level a fade counts as silent and stops at, cutscene_release_sec how fast the zone bed returns when a cutscene's music lets go.
